title: Heightened protection for operational systems
issue_presented: What extra duties apply before changing a system that is actively used or operationally important?

known_facts.fact: Task 3 recorded Law Viewer as operational Runtime with user ORDER DKT-0020.
Watchers LA-H, WI, APN run on GitHub Actions.

analysis: Operational reliance raises the cost of silent behavior change.
judgment_rule: If evidence establishes a system is actively used, relied upon, scheduled, production-like, financially or legally consequential, or otherwise operationally important, agents apply heightened change protection.

Before modifying behavior, establish: what it currently does; what it did before; whether the behavior is intentional; whether the user relies on it; which component provides it; what the change will alter; how the existing workflow is preserved; and the rollback.
Where evidence cannot answer a material question, J-0002 applies (ask the user).
operational_effect: Operational systems listed in ATLAS_RECORD REGISTRY status ACTIVE require the protection checklist in the job record before behavior-changing commits.
exceptions: Read-only audit does not require the checklist.
required_validation: Test E (Law Viewer case study — no code change to Law Viewer).
